israel|uae.summary: Official static reference identifies the UAE–Israel CEPA, in force from 1 April 2023. Product eligibility still requires HS-code, tariff-line, and rules-of-origin review.
israel|uae.source: UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism — UAE–Israel CEPA
proof_of_origin_documents: UAE–Israel CEPA proof of origin accepted by the importing customs authority
Commercial invoice with the required origin declaration where permitted
warnings: Agreement existence does not prove that the specific product qualifies for preferential duty.
recommendations: Confirm the HS code and current preferential tariff line under the UAE–Israel CEPA.
Confirm the product-specific rules of origin and accepted proof-of-origin wording before claiming preference.

iran|israel.summary: Iran–Israel trade must be treated as blocked pending current official legal, sanctions, licensing, banking, carrier, and counterparty review.
blockers: Do not book an Iran–Israel shipment unless qualified legal and customs specialists confirm that the transaction is permitted.
Official import/export licensing and sanctions review is required for the country pair, counterparties, banks, carrier, cargo, and end use.
flags: High-restriction country pair requires official verification.
Restricted-party and sanctions screening is mandatory before any commercial commitment.
conditional_documents: Country-specific import/export licence or official permit
recommendations: Obtain written confirmation from the relevant customs, export-control, sanctions, and legal authorities before proceeding.
Screen exporter, importer, beneficial owners, banks, carrier, vessel, cargo, and end user against current official restrictions.

blockers: Potential dual-use goods require export-control classification before booking.
Do not ship until the exporter confirms whether an export licence, re-export authorisation, or no-licence determination applies.
flags: Dual-use and end-use controls require specialist review.
conditional_documents: Export-control licence or written no-licence determination
Import permit or approval if required
warnings: Civilian intended use does not by itself remove dual-use controls.
recommendations: Confirm product specifications, technical parameters, HS code, export-control classification, end user, and end use.
Obtain all required export, re-export, transit, and import approvals before booking.

blockers: Lithium battery cargo requires dangerous-goods classification and carrier acceptance before booking.
flags: Battery transport documents and test evidence are required.
conditional_documents: SDS/MSDS or battery safety data sheet
warnings: Battery state, watt-hours, packing instruction, and whether batteries are standalone or packed with equipment must be confirmed.
recommendations: Confirm UN number, watt-hours, state of charge where applicable, packing instruction, labels, and UN38.3 evidence.

blockers: Radioactive Class 7 cargo is blocked pending competent-authority approval, certified packaging, security controls, and carrier acceptance.
Do not book until radioactive-material import/export permits and package certification are confirmed.
flags: Radioactive Class 7 specialist compliance review is mandatory.
warnings: Radioactive cargo cannot be handled as ordinary freight.
recommendations: Confirm radionuclide, activity, package type, transport index, labels, security plan, route restrictions, and emergency arrangements with qualified specialists.
